image_description: Three young adults (two males, one female) standing side-by-side wearing dark blue academic regalia. They are wearing square mortarboard caps with tassels and matching gowns with yellow/gold velvet panels on the shoulders and front opening. The background is a plain, light-colored brick wall.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the waist/chest level; the lower half of the garments and ankles are not visible.
All three subjects display clear bilateral symmetry in their gown design with a distinct vertical center-front opening revealing the shirt/tie underneath.
The fabric hangs loosely and does not cling to the torso, effectively obscuring the specific body shape beneath, consistent with academic robes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The arms are mostly out of frame or obscured by the angle; the specific length of the sleeve extensions relative to the hands cannot be verified.

Collared shirts and ties are clearly visible through the front opening of the gowns on all three subjects.

Contradicts the visual evidence; the fabric has a semi-gloss or satin finish, reflecting light sources, rather than being non-reflective.

The caps appear slightly warped and lack rigid geometric precision. The edges of the boards do not appear perfectly straight, and the connection point of the tassel button is indistinct/fused.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight blurring where the gown collar meets the neck and hair, lacking sharp boundary definition typical of AI generation.
